note: Backup taken before switching the doorbell from 'open the Cameras dashboard' to 'live view with audio on the Home Front Door tile'. To revert: restore the automation config below, and set views[0].cards[0].custom_fields.cam1 in claude-test-dashboard back to cam1_before.

automation.doorbell_tablet_chime_and_cam.description: When the Front Door doorbell is pressed, wake the wall tablet, announce it out loud, and switch the tablet to the Cameras page for two minutes before returning it to the main dashboard. Mode is restart so a second press restarts the two minutes rather than cutting it short.
